title: Judge tests in four languages with ten rules
what: Running `test-lint check <paths>` finds the tests in TypeScript, Python, Rust and Go source -- including vitest in-source tests and Rust `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` inside production files -- asks Jev one question per rule per test, and reports findings in a fixed schema that an agent can act on and re-run to verify.

acceptance.text: Tests are found by construct rather than by file path, so in-source tests in production files are judged
Extraction agrees with each runner's own discovery: vp test list, pytest --collect-only -q, go test -list, cargo test -- --list
Two runs over the same input print identical findings, and --replay re-scores a recorded run without a request
A failed or unusable answer reports messageId missing and never reads as a clean result
--deterministic refuses a rule that declares model and the run makes no network request
The API key is absent from process.env while plugin code runs
Ten rules ship, each with a canary set, and each rule's precision and recall are in the README
Every finding carries ruleId, file, line and subjectSource
